info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Data Switch Operation Routing Decision-spec
info.description: The Market Data Routing Decisions API facilitates the management of routing decisions for market data operations within the banking sector. This endpoint allows users to create new routing decision specifications that determine how market data is processed and directed. Typical consumers include financial institutions and application developers seeking to optimize their market data workflows. Through this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making capabilities, ensuring data flows efficiently and effectively to improve trading strategies.

post.summary: Create a new routing decision for market data operations.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a routing decision in the market data switch operation. You can specify various parameters to define the routing rules which will be used for processing incoming market data requests.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the routing decisions for the market data switch operation. The payload must adhere to the defined schema to ensure correct processing of the routing information.
